scheme_name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
benefits_summary: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study (up to 4 years) for girl students admitted to first-year AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses.
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under AICTE schemes.
Fill the Pragati Scholarship form and upload admission and income certificates.
Get online verification completed by your technical institution.
